caseNameFull: T. R. Bennett, Superintendent of Banks for the State of Georgia v. John E. Schwarz
attorneys: Mr. George M. Napier and Mr. Paul E. Seabrook for petitioner. Mr. H. Wiley Johnson for respondents.

opinions.text: Petition for a writ of certiorari to the Supreme Court of the State of Georgia denied for lack of a final decree.
